B wrote its own fact list from the paper before opening A (tmp/1122-coverage/checkerB-hist/B_facts_before_A.txt); verified every id A cited with checkerB-hist/verifyA.mjs (served list + full text; deck + front/back/quote); searched every A not-covered item in the served rows, the deck, the quarantine file and the NCERT text (pdftotext and pdfium of ncert-books/pdf/lehs1xx-3xx; checkerB-hist/s.mjs, pdfium_grep.py); built by checkerB-hist/buildB.py.

auditOfA.note: Every bank id A cited is in served_history.json and was read in full (stem, options, key, explanation); every card id is in data/keycards/decks/history.json and its front, back and NCERT quote were read. Each states what A attached to it. Two corrections that are not citation removals: Q16's chapter is Thinkers, Beliefs & Buildings (the card and the NCERT definition sit in lehs104 p89), and the Nikitin card A mentions in its Q20 reason is in the Vijayanagara chapter (kc.history.an-imperial-capital-vijayanagara.fact-nikitin), which B cites.
